name: project
description: One thing a community is trying to bring into being, with every facet it needs at once: what is being built, what it would cost to run, what is still needed in people and in money, what has been decided, and what it becomes afterwards. A project is not a campaign that ends when a target is reached; the target is a stage in a life that continues as a living publication. Nothing recorded here is money held, promised, owed, or authorized to spend.
